title: Measuring the right thing: justifying metrics in AI impact assessments
benchmark_measurement: Not applicable. The paper does not create, use, or discuss any benchmarks related to faith or religion.
findings: The paper does not analyze or mention religion or faith. Its focus is on the philosophical and methodological justification of metrics for AI impact assessments, with a specific emphasis on the concept of fairness.
